name: 31493-decodeheavy-minimaxm2-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- half of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one in-process vLLM engine; TP=4 is the only clean width here, since the block-quantized MoE path needs the per-rank expert intermediate to be a multiple of 128 and 1536/4 = 384 is.
architecture: 62-layer sparse-MoE decoder, natively FP8 (float8_e4m3fn, weight block [128,128]), 228.7B parameters, 230 GB on disk, ~57.5 GB per GPU at TP=4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=2, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 128 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 31493.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 256 prompt tokens in and exactly 512 tokens out per request, single turn, min == max on both lengths.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 229-billion-parameter model, serving two concurrent users short prompts across four GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.14.0rc0-era engine arguments: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.1
tensor-parallel-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
